body: Source review of ae0cd8e4/c7f28b6c found a concrete unshown-presentation liveness gap. presentDocumentSaveSheet sets saveAsPresentationID before SwiftUI onAppear; cancelDocumentSave clears presentedSaveAs but leaves that ID. If canceled or superseded synchronously before the first view update, no sheet appears, presentedID in the modifier stays nil, and no onDismiss can release the old ID. Every later Save As queues behind it forever. Please add a deterministic begin/cancel/begin-without-appearance regression and correct the requested-versus-actually-presented lifecycle without timers or guessing native dismissal. Coordinate a captured presentation identity handshake at the SwiftUI boundary; retain safety for a sheet in the process of appearing. Preserve original failed GUI evidence. Work source-only on your existing branch, no builds/apps/heartbeat restart; A owns compile and GUI. Return a separate source/test checkpoint and explicit limits. A remains sole main integrator.
